other_conditions: All technical institutes in Tripura are eligible.
Host institutes are selected based on their infrastructure, quality of faculty, and excellence in education.

Minimum infrastructure required: at least 1000 sq ft carpet area, 10 computers with Core i5/i7 (5th Gen), 1 TB HDD, 4‑6 GB RAM, 3 GHz CPU, 21‑inch monitor, workspaces for up to 5 projects/teams, furnished incubation room with AC and interior decoration, high‑speed dedicated internet, uninterrupted power backup, projection facility, and a discussion/meeting room.
Host institute must appoint one dedicated start‑up coordinator who is a technical/management graduate with at least 5 years industry experience in sales/marketing.
Host institute must select a minimum of two faculty mentors in specific technology/specialisation areas.
Host institution must open a separate bank account in any nationalised bank to receive grants.
Polytechnic institutes and general government degree colleges will be selected based on the number of IT‑related courses offered and a student strength of more than 100.
benefits_summary: The host institute receives a one‑time grant of ₹10 lakhs, an annual operational funding of ₹5 lakhs, and project funding of up to ₹1 lakh per team (maximum five projects per year).
